profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft | Azure Growth | Real Estate Entrepreneur | Hobbyist
profile.summary:
Full Stack Software Engineer with several years of experience building and maintaining reliable, secure, and scalable applications. My work spans both frontend and backend development, where I enjoy bringing together modern frameworks, cloud platforms, and strong engineering practices to create seamless user experiences. I thrive in collaborative environments, working closely with cross-functional teams to translate complex requirements into effective solutions that align with organizational goals.

My background includes developing web applications, designing APIs, and implementing automation to improve the overall software development lifecycle. I place a strong emphasis on clean architecture, maintainability, and continuous improvement, ensuring that the systems I work on remain adaptable and future-ready. I’m passionate about applying technology thoughtfully—balancing innovation with stability—and I’m eager to continue contributing to teams where software engineering makes a measurable difference for both users and businesses.
